##### Project general facts

Mas Tower is a modern residential complex developed by Revi Realty, featuring eight residential levels and a panoramic rooftop pool. Residence formats include 1 and 2 bedroom apartments, designed with thoughtful layouts and modern interiors. The tower is characterized by an elegant facade reflecting current urban architectural trends.

Amenities within Mas Tower include a rooftop swimming pool with a relaxation area, a modern fitness center equipped with high-quality gym equipment, a multi-purpose event room for residents, and an outdoor barbecue area. The complex also offers exceptionally designed kitchens provided by Revi, featuring appliances such as a fridge-freezer, hob, extensible hood, dishwasher, microwave, oven, and washing machine. 

Interiors throughout Mas Tower showcase modern finishing with high-quality materials, reflecting a prestigious and exclusive design aesthetic. Fully furnished options are available for residents seeking a seamless move-in experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a cutting-edge technology park and residential community located in Dubai. It spans over 7.2 square kilometres and is strategically situated on the Emirates Road, providing easy access to Dubai's major highways and landmarks.

As a hub for technology and innovation, Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to numerous multinational technology companies, startups, and research institutions. It offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of the tech industry, including advanced telecommunications, data centres, and modern office spaces.

In addition to its technological prowess, Dubai Silicon Oasis is also a vibrant residential community. Residents enjoy a plethora of amenities, such as schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, parks, and recreational areas, creating a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle.
